hooks.name: contract-before-code
hooks.description: Before writing under src/, the task contract has to be complete: no fact without a source, no blocking assumption left open, no pending question. It is the only gate that catches a missing requirement — the others look at the code, and code that is wrong for the right reason passes them all.

hooks.name: format-on-save
hooks.description: The formatter decides the style. No formatting discussion ever reaches the diff.

hooks.name: gates-before-stopping
hooks.description: The task only ends with the gates green. The runner executes them in parallel and reports every problem at once, so the repair fits in a single round — chaining with && would hide the others and cost one invocation per problem.

hooks.name: secrets-before-commit
hooks.description: A leaked credential is the most concrete risk of working with an agent that has shell access.
